nonDefaultUriAddition.description: Block new identifier URIs for applications, unless they are the 'default' URI of the format api://{appId} or api://{tenantId}/{appId}.

uriAdditionWithoutUniqueTenantIdentifier.description: Block new identifier URIs for applications, unless they contain a unique tenant identifier like the tenant ID, appId (client ID), or verified domain. For example, api://{tenantId}/string, api://{appId}/string, {scheme}://string/{tenantId}, {scheme}://string/{appId}, https://{verified-domain.com}/path, {scheme}://{subdomain}.{verified-domain.com}/path.
